items.title: Amberes Seis Cuatro opens in Mexico City Zona Rosa
items.description: Choice Hotels CALA inaugurated Amberes Seis Cuatro Ascend Hotel Collection in Mexico City's Zona Rosa—minutes from Ángel de la Independencia, with restaurant, bar, gym, steam area, and kitchenette-equipped rooms.

items.title: Comfort Inn Puebla Centro Histórico debuts
items.description: Choice Hotels CALA opened Comfort Inn Puebla Centro Histórico—a nine-story, 54-room hotel on Av. Juárez beside Paseo Bravo, with buffet breakfast, meetings for up to 41 guests, and valet parking.

items.title: Sleep Inn Puebla Centro Histórico opens
items.description: Choice Hotels CALA opened Sleep Inn Puebla Centro Histórico at 4 Norte 1206—54 rooms across five floors, steps from Puebla's historic center, with complimentary breakfast and meeting space for up to 50 guests.

items.title: Faranda Collection Medellín joins Individuals
items.description: Choice Hotels CALA expanded Radisson Individuals in Colombia with Faranda Collection Medellín—a 141-room upscale property in El Poblado, strengthening the brand's thirteenth hotel in the country.

items.title: RED signed in greater Rosario corridor
items.description: Choice Hotels announced Radisson RED Funes in the greater Rosario area as part of its CALA expansion into Argentina alongside Radisson Blu Bariloche and Radisson Hotel Paramaribo.
